extracted_concepts.name: 微分方程的应用
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 第四章讨论微分方程在物理、生物和方程组中的应用

extracted_concepts.name: 微分方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 含有未知函数及其导数的方程

extracted_concepts.name: 弹簧振动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 弹簧质量系统的振动模型

extracted_concepts.name: 简谐运动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 无阻尼情况下满足 x'' + ω₀²x = 0 的周期运动

extracted_concepts.name: 弹簧振动方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: mx'' + cx' + kx = F(t)

extracted_concepts.name: 无阻尼简谐振动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x'' + ω₀²x = 0 描述的简谐振动

extracted_concepts.name: 有阻尼振动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x'' + 2γx' + ω₀²x = 0 描述的衰减振动

extracted_concepts.name: 指数衰减
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 有阻尼振动中振幅随时间指数衰减

extracted_concepts.name: 受迫振动
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x'' + 2γx' + ω₀²x = f₀cosωt 描述的外力驱动振动

extracted_concepts.name: 共振
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 受迫振动在激励频率接近固有频率时的响应增强

extracted_concepts.name: 电路方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 由电路元件建立的微分方程

extracted_concepts.name: LR 电路方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L(dI/dt) + RI = E(t)

extracted_concepts.name: RC 电路方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: R(dQ/dt) + Q/C = E(t)

extracted_concepts.name: LRC 电路方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L(d²Q/dt²) + R(dQ/dt) + Q/C = E(t)

extracted_concepts.name: 放射性衰变模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dN/dt = -λN → N = N₀e^(-λt)

extracted_concepts.name: 人口增长模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 描述人口数量随时间变化的模型

extracted_concepts.name: 马尔萨斯模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dP/dt = rP → P = P₀e^(rt)

extracted_concepts.name: 逻辑斯蒂模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dP/dt = rP(1 - P/K)

extracted_concepts.name: 传染病模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 描述传染病传播的模型

extracted_concepts.name: SIR 模型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dS/dt = -βSI, dI/dt = βSI - γI, dR/dt = γI

extracted_concepts.name: 常微分方程组
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 多个未知函数的一阶导数方程组

extracted_concepts.name: 一阶方程组
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dx/dt = f(x, y, t), dy/dt = g(x, y, t)

extracted_concepts.name: 化高阶方程为方程组
aliases: reduction of higher-order equation to system
高阶方程降阶为方程组
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 令 x₁ = y, x₂ = y', ..., xₙ = y⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵方法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 用矩阵和矩阵指数求解线性微分方程组

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵指数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x' = Ax 的解为 x = e^(At)x₀

extracted_concepts.name: 系数矩阵特征值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 决定系统动力学行为的矩阵特征值

extracted_concepts.name: 动力学行为
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 微分方程组解所表现出的系统行为

extracted_concepts.name: 线性代数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 矩阵、特征值等代数工具
